name: How do I care for and maintain my new laminate flooring?

mainEntity.name: How do I care for and maintain my new laminate flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Caring for laminate flooring is relatively straightforward and essential for maintaining its appearance and longevity. Regularly sweep or vacuum with a soft brush attachment to remove dirt and grit that can scratch the surface. For cleaning, use a damp mop or a laminate-specific cleaner, avoiding excessive water, which can damage the core. Promptly wipe up spills to prevent moisture penetration. Avoid using abrasive cleaners, waxes, or steam mops, as these can dull the finish or cause damage. Placing felt pads under furniture legs can also prevent scratches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain laminate flooring by regular sweeping, vacuuming with a soft brush, and cleaning with a damp mop or laminate-specific cleaner. Avoid excess water and abrasive products.
